contea di ritrovamento: North Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ VOCTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES

A copper alloy Roman coin; a nummus of Decentius, VOCTORIAE DD NN AVG ET CAES reverse type showing two Victories holding a wreath inscribed VOT / V / MVLT / X supported on a column and dating from AD 351 - 353 (Reece Period 18). Mint of Lyon. See LRBC number 220 on page 50
